features: Android 14 Smart Projector with Screen Sharing and Live TV: The WZATCO Yuva Lunar Projector runs on Android 14, delivering a smooth and user-friendly smart entertainment experience. Enjoy your favorite movies, shows, and content with ease, or wirelessly share and mirror content from compatible smartphones, tablets, and laptops for a convenient big-screen home cinema experience. With the pre-installed MovieARK Live TV app, you can also access a variety of live TV channels without the need for a separate subscription

Ultra Bright 750 ANSI with Fully Automatic Setup: Experience bright and immersive visuals with the WZATCO Lunar's powerful True 750 ANSI brightness. Its fully automatic setup with Auto Focus and Auto Keystone Correction quickly adjusts the image for a sharp, properly aligned picture with obstacle avoidance and screen adaptation, making setup effortless every time

WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0 with Dual 5W Speakers: Enjoy fast and stable wireless connectivity with WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0. Connect compatible wireless headphones, speakers, keyboards, and other Bluetooth devices with ease. The built-in dual 5W speakers with Bass Radiator deliver clear, punchy and immersive stereo sound for an enjoyable entertainment experience

Auto Screen Adaptation with 270 Degree Rotatable Design: Enjoy effortless projection with intelligent Auto Screen Adaptation and Auto Obstacle Avoidance. The projector automatically adjusts the image to fit the available screen area while detecting obstacles in the projection path. Its 270 degree rotatable design provides flexible placement and lets you project from different angles with ease

Sealed Optical Engine for Dust Protection: The sealed optical engine helps protect the internal optical components from dust, supporting consistent image quality and reliable long-term performance. Designed for everyday home entertainment, the Yuva Lunar combines smart features, powerful brightness, and convenient automatic setup

Native 1080P FHD Resolution with 4K Ultra HD Support: The projector delivers Native 1080P Full HD resolution and supports 4K Ultra HD content playback, ensuring sharp and detailed visuals for movies, gaming, and streaming content on screens up to large sizes
